name: JSS stencil (authored documents)
description: Page geometry and typography read from the JSS-0251 stencils (UHB, MM, ORM share them): A4, mirrored margins 25 mm inner / 15 mm outer, top 20 mm and bottom 13.5 mm with the header at 10 mm and the footer at 2.5 mm; Arial 12 pt at 1.15, chapter title 18 pt, section headings 14 pt capitals and 12 pt below. See docs/JSS_STENCIL_ANALYSIS.md.

parts.title: General
paras: The demolition procedure outlined below will be used to prevent the enemy from using or salvaging this equipment. DEMOLITION OF THE EQUIPMENT WILL BE DONE ONLY ON ORDER OF THE COMMANDER.

parts.title: Methods of Destruction
paras: Use any or all the following methods to destroy the equipment.
items: Smash - Smash the Crystals, Controls, Semiconductors, Coils, Switches, Transformers and Headsets, use Sledges, Hand-axes, Pickaxes, Hammers crowbars or heavy tools, if applicable.
Cut - Cut the Cords, Headsets and Wiring: use axes, hand-axes or hatchets, if applicable.
Burn - Burn the Cords, Resistors, Capacitors, Coils, Wiring, and Technical Manuals, use Gasoline, Kerosene, Oil, Flamethrowers or Incendiary, if applicable.
Bend - Bend the panels, cabinet and chassis, if applicable.
Explosives - If explosives are necessary, use firearms, grenades or TNT, if applicable.
Disposal - Bury or scatter the destroyed parts in slits trenches, fox holes or other holes or throw them into streams, if applicable.
